summary: SiteRecruitmentOpportunities is a user control for managing recruitment opportunities related to a specific site. It enables users to add, edit, delete, and view opportunities, with UI elements and backend logic to handle different workflow scenarios including data binding, field validation, conditional visibility, and CRUD operations. The system integrates user session management, permission checks (editability), and redirects users upon completion of certain actions.
purpose: Facilitate the creation, modification, deletion, and display of recruitment opportunities at a site, with appropriate user interface controls and workflow logic that respects user permissions and session state.

workflows.name: Data Binding and Initialization
steps: On Page_Load, control initializes but takes no visible action.
On dsProfile_Selecting, input parameters for session and SiteID are set or cancelled if session missing.
On fvwProfile_DataBound, bindings are established for dropdowns (headings), and values are set from SiteOpportunity when editing.

workflows.name: Add/Edit/Delete Site Opportunity
steps: User initiates add/edit/delete via GridView commands.
On cmdAdd or cmdAddEmptyData, switch to Add mode, provide templates, and bind blank or template data.
On cmdEdit, switch to Edit mode, bind selected SiteOpportunity data.
On cmdDelete, retrieve SiteOpportunity by ID, execute delete, and redirect.
On Save (cmdSave), collect field values, validate, update or add SiteOpportunity, hide details, and redirect if not cancelled.

workflows.name: UI Control Visibility Logic
steps: On gvwProfile_RowDataBound, setup buttons based on editability, hide/reveal description panels depending on header change.
On gvwProfile_DataBound, show 'no data found' button if no rows and screen is editable.
Switch label/hyperlink fields for response depending on whether it is a web page.

business_rules: ScreenIsEditable determines whether add/edit/delete buttons and certain panels are visible.
If SortOrder textbox is empty, default to -1.
Dropdown for HeadingID bound to Headings of type SiteOpportunities.
validations: UserSession must exist for data operations.
SortOrder must be an integer, defaults to -1 if not provided.
HeadingID must be a valid dropdown selection.
calculations: SortOrder: Uses input value or defaults to -1.
conditions: Show 'no data found' add button only if GridView has no rows and screen is editable.
Reveal/hide description panels based on CD.HeaderChanged flag.
Show hyperlink for response only if CD.WebPage flag is true, otherwise show label.
system_behavior: Handles CRUD operations for SiteOpportunity records.
Redirects user after add/update/delete unless cancelled.
Hides modal popup after completion of form actions.
dependencies: Grid utility functions for UI interactions.
exceptions: If UserSession is not set, cancel data selection.
Fallback to EditItemTemplate for InsertItemTemplate in Add mode.
Redirect with ReadOnly=1 if screen is not editable.
